title: The plan
rule: Each panel pairs what the 4:15 memo planned, ghosted in pale ink, with what happened; the ghost door opens, the real one stays shut.
declares: adds an unrealised planned strand, marked as ghost
made: six panels drawn with page 51's one pen (the folio's 4.42 px pen along b1m2's HANDMADE figure-model outlines, hidden lines lifted), in two inks: the plan in a pale washed blue-grey (62% wash), what happened in full black

the ghost strand (an unrealised plan, declared by the canon): the agent rising and taking the dotted route straight to the cupboard, walking on past the window, lifting the key off its hook from a ghost-open cupboard, carrying it to the SERVICE door, turning it at 4:14, the ghost door swinging open at 4:15 with him stepping through

the solid strand: E0-E5 with the four canon lines in pen-drawn balloons; the real cupboard drawn shut while the ghost one stands open over it (panel 3); the real SERVICE door drawn shut under the open ghost leaf (panel 6)
a two-line caption at each panel's head in the shared pen hand: 'Plan: ...' in the ghost ink, 'Fact: ...' in black

captions.plan: Plan: up from the desk, straight to the cupboard.
captions.fact: Fact: he rises and sets off.

captions.plan: Plan: on past the ticket window.
captions.fact: Fact: a voice at the window stops him.

captions.plan: Plan: the key lifted off its hook.
captions.fact: Fact: he looks up at the clock.

captions.plan: Plan: key in hand, on to the SERVICE door.
captions.fact: Fact: she thanks him and goes.

captions.plan: Plan: 4:14, the key turns in the lock.
captions.fact: Fact: the cupboard opens on the key.
Fact: the key stays; the door stays shut.

ghost: rises and heads straight for the cupboard (dotted route)
at the open cupboard, lifts the key off its hook
carries the key toward the SERVICE door
turns the key in the SERVICE door's lock
the ghost leaf of the SERVICE door swings open; he steps through

events.E0: 1: memo on the desk; he rises and sets off (ghost: already striding along the dotted route to the cupboard)
events.E1: 2: the stranger at the TICKET OFFICE window: 'Pardon me — have you the right time?' (ghost walks on past)
events.E2: 3: he looks up at the clock, 4:10: 'Ten past four, by the clock.' (ghost lifts the key from the ghost-open cupboard; the real one is shut)
events.E3: 4: 'Much obliged!' as she turns away (ghost carries the key to the SERVICE door)
events.E4: 5: the cupboard open, the key on its hook, tagged SERVICE (ghost at the lock, 4:14)
events.E5: 6: pencil to chin, 'Well, here I am... and what for?'; key on hook, the real SERVICE door shut; the ghost door open at 4:15

lines.question: Pardon me — have you the right time?
lines.answer: Ten past four, by the clock.
lines.forgetting: Well, here I am... and what for?

beat: what happened lies drawn in black; the plan is washed in beside it panel by panel in pale ink; last the ghost door swings open over the real one, which stays shut
beat_frames: b05: panel 6 ghost door half open
b06: ghost door open, ghost agent going through; the real door shut
